messages.subject: Tessaract Bioreagents / Hartwell Pharma — response to LBA
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

We act for Tessaract Bioreagents Limited. Please find attached our response to your letter before action. Liability is denied. Our client maintains that the batch was compliant on the parameters tested, that any breach was not deliberate, and that liability (if any) is capped at £250,000 under clause 14. Without admission, our client is willing to mediate.

Yours faithfully,
Robert Mason
Thackeray Wolfe LLP

messages.subject: RE: Tessaract Bioreagents / Hartwell Pharma — response to LBA
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Mason,

Thank you. We note your client's position and reject it. The contractual obligation under clause 4.1 is to conform to specification, not merely to pass the methods your client chose to run, and the unnotified change of starting-material supplier is a deliberate breach to which clause 14.4 applies. Our client will issue proceedings shortly.

We will revert separately on the suggestion of mediation, to which our client is in principle open once pleadings have crystallised the issues.

Yours faithfully,
Sarah Whitfield

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
